description: From a colonial street in the historic center, the cobbled street runs between whitewashed facades toward the cathedral tower rising at the end of the view. Street lamps warm the stone and the wooden balconies overhead, while the tower's silhouette stands against the night sky. La Laguna is a UNESCO-listed colonial town, and its grid of lantern-lit streets is one of the Canaries' most atmospheric night walks.
